name: Simeon Decker
milestones: Buried at Battle Creek, Calhoun County, Michigan
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Bicha-Dale Family Tree" (tree 8839537)
notes: Son of Peter and Olive Catherine (Simons) Decker.

Born 17 Jan 1881 in Northwest Township, Williams County, Ohio. He married Ardella M. Sisson on 1 Apr 1919 at Marshall, Michigan; the Bicha-Dale tree records no children. The tree gives his death as 17 Aug 1949 at Pennfield Township, Calhoun County, and his burial as 19 Aug 1949 at Battle Creek.
